reason: My own branded app on the stylists' phones, WhatsApp bills and the cash-drawer check would make the parlour look modern and stop me chasing the register, and with the first month free I can test it properly. ₹999 is one or two haircuts a month, so if the wallet and reminders bring even a few customers back it pays for itself.
objection: ₹4,999 setup up front plus ₹999 every month even in slow months, and I'm not sure my staff will actually do the selfie check-in and type every walk-in number instead of skipping it when it's busy.
would_change_my_mind: If after the free month my stylists aren't using it and I can't see real repeat customers from the WhatsApp reminders, I'd cancel; and if the setup fee can't be refunded or waived for that case, I'd hold off at the start.
